tickets.title: Prepare side-by-side care option comparison for Velvetreeds
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side comparison of in-home aide coverage, adult day programming, short respite stays, transportation, and likely out-of-pocket costs for Harold and Lena Velvetreed under several weekly care-hour levels, reflecting the neurologist's recommendation of 20 to 24 hours per week of in-home aide support and physical therapy twice weekly.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison by 2026-01-20.

tickets.title: Build family caregiver coverage map for Velvetreeds
tickets.text: Build a family caregiver coverage map for Harold and Lena Velvetreed that reflects Sofia Copperwisp's weekend overnight availability (one weekend per month, about 35 miles away), Martin Velvetreed's remote medication refill role from Portland, Harold's fatigue, and the weekday evening gaps in coverage.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to build a family caregiver coverage map by 2026-01-16.

tickets.title: Prepare Silver Marmot Insurance claim intake packet
tickets.text: Prepare the Silver Marmot Insurance claim intake packet for Harold and Lena Velvetreed, organizing physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and policy questions for the pending claim-intake appointment, including the 90-day elimination period and the daily benefit maximums of $220 (Harold) and $180 (Lena).
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the intake packet by 2026-01-12.

tickets.title: Resolve aide shift minimums in care cost estimates
tickets.text: Resolve the inconsistent aide shift minimums in the projected weekly care cost estimates for Harold and Lena Velvetreed, reconciling the four-hour daytime minimum from one agency quote with the three-hour visits shown in Sofia Copperwisp's call notes.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to resolve the aide shift minimums in the cost estimates by 2026-01-13.

tickets.title: Correct Lena Velvetreed's secure upload access
tickets.text: Correct Lena Velvetreed's secure upload access so she has a separate upload stream for care records, health forms, and aide invoices tied to her Silver Marmot Insurance claim file, since her portal invitation currently opened under Harold's login.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to correct secure upload access by 2026-01-09.

tickets.title: Address Silver Marmot policy benefit inflation assumptions
tickets.text: Address the differing inflation rider language in Harold and Lena Velvetreed's two Silver Marmot Insurance long-term care policies and clarify how the daily benefit maximums ($220 for Harold, $180 for Lena) should be shown in the care-cost projections.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to address the policy benefit inflation assumptions by 2026-01-23.
